labs.name: compataai
labs.note: The reviewer's own lab for the ai phase (DOC-030 used inboxai). Created with scripts/documentation/lab.mjs create compataai --commit 4ca41822 --app-port 43396 --mail-port 48496 --backend-subnet 10.243.96.0/24 --engine-subnet 10.244.96.0/24, then up and seed. The stand-in provider-standin.mjs ran in container doc032-compata-inbox-provider (node:22-alpine) on the lab backend network, control port on 127.0.0.1 only; key and control token lived in /tmp and were deleted. Stand-in and lab destroyed at 2026-09-28T07:41:58Z.

browser: Playwright 1.63.0 Chromium from node_modules, headless, 1440x1000 staff and 1280x900 Portal; one isolated browser context per identity

runs.note: Full replay. Administrator passed every step. The Legal Team Member convert steps on R-45 failed because another compat-a helper's end-of-run SQL cleanup (legal_name like 'DOC-032 compat compat-a %') archived this replay's live fixture Entity 'DOC-032 compat compat-a inbox Live Holdings Ltd' at 07:20:02Z, so the Entity picker no longer offered it (selectOption timed out) and the later C-/Portal checks had no record. Fixture reason; superseded by work-3.
Stopped before any step: the magic-link request for rosa.iglesias@helix.example answered 429 (sign-in link budget, 3 per address per 15 minutes, shared with other agents). No steps recorded.
Rerun after restoring the fixture Entity through the API and submitting fresh Requests R-53 to R-57 from Rosa Iglesias. All steps passed.

AI phase with the local provider stand-in. Administrator passed every step. Legal Team Member: the completion-notification step timed out and the four dependent steps failed. The notification existed (created 07:27:26Z, unread); the script checked the bell item the instant the list opened, before Nadia Haddad's longer list (with a 'Your approvals' group) had loaded, and then reloaded every 3 s. Timing reason; superseded by compataai-3.

Same script on fresh Requests R-24 to R-27 to confirm the cause; the same five steps failed the same way. A probe showed the bell item was not visible at the click and was visible 2 s later. Superseded by compataai-3.
openBellItem now waits up to 8 s for the item to load before checking it (timing only; the step, its expected result and its check are unchanged). Fresh Requests R-28 to R-31. All steps passed.
